assessment.name: AI Sales Risk Assessment
assessment.description: Cybersecurity and AI risk assessment for a synthetic sales recommendation system.

risks.title: Customer data disclosure through compromised identity or service
risks.rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Severe privacy/trust impact; identity attacks are credible while real IAM and data exposure are unknown.

risks.title: Training data poisoning or corruption
risks.risk_source: Insider supply chain or process failure
risks.rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Corruption may scale into systematic recommendations; real lineage validation and approvals are unknown.

risks.title: Open-source AI/software supply-chain compromise
risks.rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Open-source reliance is known but exact sources provenance build isolation and credentials are unknown.

risks.title: Unauthorized model modification or deployment
risks.rationale: [ASSUMPTION] A privileged change can affect recommendations at scale; promotion controls are unknown.

risks.title: Model extraction or inference privacy attack
risks.rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Feasibility depends on interface access output precision rate limits and training-data sensitivity.

risks.title: Recommendation service denial or dependency outage
risks.rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Business impact and fallback/RTO are unknown; exposed APIs and AI compute can be resource constrained.

risks.title: Unfair or invalid group performance
risks.rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Customer impact is potentially severe; actual groups uses thresholds and legal context are unknown.

risks.title: Undetected model/data drift degrades recommendations
risks.rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Periodic use implies drift can occur; monitoring and retraining triggers are unknown.

risks.title: Privileged insider misuse across data model or administration
risks.rationale: [ASSUMPTION] Privileged access is necessary somewhere in the lifecycle; actual separation monitoring and reviews are unknown.

risks.title: Sensitive data leakage through logs and evidence
risks.rationale: [ASSUMPTION] ML observability may collect high-dimensional request/output data; log schema and access are unknown.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.control_objective: Provision review and remove human/service accounts across data ML registry API and logging
controls.reference_implementation: Enterprise lifecycle plus non-shared service identities
controls.evidence_required: Account inventory; lifecycle tickets; periodic review

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.control_objective: Enforce authorized purpose and role at every interface
controls.reference_implementation: Gateway/IAM policy and resource-level checks; lab API key demonstrates only a boundary
controls.evidence_required: Policy/configuration; positive and negative authorization tests

controls.title: Separation of Duties
controls.control_objective: Separate data change model development validation approval and deployment
controls.reference_implementation: Two-person promotion and independent validation

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.control_objective: Grant minimum data model deployment and log access
controls.reference_implementation: Scoped roles and short-lived workload identities
controls.evidence_required: Role grants; access review; token claims

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.control_objective: Define and log security and model-lifecycle events
controls.reference_implementation: Lab emits request/model/outcome metadata without raw feature body
controls.evidence_required: Event catalog; sample logs; stakeholder approval

controls.title: Content of Audit Records
controls.control_objective: Record who what when where result and model/version context
controls.reference_implementation: Structured lab events include request ID action result and model version

controls.title: Audit Record Review Analysis and Reporting
controls.control_objective: Detect abnormal access export query and administrative behavior
controls.reference_implementation: Alerts for query bursts exports failed integrity and model promotion

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.control_objective: Prevent unauthorized log access modification and deletion
controls.reference_implementation: Restricted append-only central logging

controls.title: Audit Record Retention
controls.control_objective: Retain audit data for approved security legal and privacy needs
controls.reference_implementation: Documented retention with deletion and legal-hold rules

controls.title: Control Assessments
controls.control_objective: Independently assess selected security privacy and model-risk controls
controls.reference_implementation: Use this assessment plan with qualified independent reviewers

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.control_objective: Monitor controls system changes vulnerabilities quality and risk
controls.reference_implementation: Drift quality abuse security and availability metrics with triggers

controls.title: Configuration Change Control
controls.control_objective: Review approve test and record data feature model threshold and deployment changes
controls.reference_implementation: Pull requests plus protected approval environment

controls.title: Access Restrictions for Change
controls.control_objective: Restrict who can modify code data models thresholds and deployment
controls.reference_implementation: Protected branches registry ACL and deploy role
controls.evidence_required: Settings export; role test; audit trail

controls.title: Contingency Plan
controls.control_objective: Define service fallback recovery roles communications and exercises
controls.reference_implementation: Manual sales fallback and dependency/model rollback plan

controls.title: System Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.control_objective: Restore a known-good service and model within approved objectives
controls.reference_implementation: Immutable prior model and tested restore procedure

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.control_objective: Uniquely authenticate users with stronger protection for privileged access
controls.reference_implementation: Enterprise SSO and phishing-resistant MFA
controls.evidence_required: IdP policy; MFA test; exception list

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.control_objective: Coordinate detection analysis containment eradication recovery and post-incident action
controls.reference_implementation: AI/data/model incident playbooks linked to enterprise response

controls.title: Incident Reporting
controls.control_objective: Report security privacy supplier and AI incidents to required parties
controls.reference_implementation: Notification matrix with timeframes and owner

controls.title: Incident Response Plan
controls.control_objective: Maintain approved response plan covering AI lifecycle and dependencies
controls.reference_implementation: Model rollback data quarantine customer response and supplier coordination

controls.title: Risk Management Strategy
controls.control_objective: Set risk appetite methods responsibilities and decision rules
controls.reference_implementation: Approved AI/system risk strategy and escalation thresholds

controls.title: Authority to Process Personally Identifiable Information
controls.control_objective: Document authority and purpose for each PII processing activity
controls.reference_implementation: Data inventory purpose/lawful-authority record and change review

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.control_objective: Maintain scenario based system and AI risk assessment
controls.reference_implementation: EBIOS analysis reviewed after architecture and material change
controls.evidence_required: Approved assessment; review record; threat inputs

controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles
controls.control_objective: Apply secure privacy-preserving and human-centered design principles
controls.reference_implementation: Minimize outputs human review fail-safe behavior and contestability
controls.evidence_required: Design review; UI test; threat model

controls.title: Developer Configuration Management
controls.control_objective: Version and control code data configuration documentation and releases
controls.reference_implementation: Git plus dataset/model digests and release linkage
controls.evidence_required: Repository settings; tagged release; lineage record

controls.title: Supply Chain Protection
controls.control_objective: Protect against supplier package model image and service compromise
controls.reference_implementation: Risk-based supplier controls trusted sources and build isolation

controls.title: Denial-of-Service Protection
controls.control_objective: Protect capacity and degrade safely
controls.reference_implementation: Gateway limits timeouts quotas and manual fallback
controls.evidence_required: Load/abuse test; rate-limit config; fallback exercise

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.control_objective: Control connections and information flows across trust zones
controls.reference_implementation: Private endpoints egress restriction gateway and segmented ML zone

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.control_objective: Protect sensitive flows in transit
controls.reference_implementation: TLS with managed certificates and authenticated service links

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.control_objective: Protect customer training model secret and backup data at rest
controls.reference_implementation: Managed encryption and keys separated from data access

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.control_objective: Identify evaluate and remediate vulnerabilities within risk-based timeframes
controls.reference_implementation: pip-audit Trivy advisories and tracked remediation

controls.title: System Monitoring
controls.control_objective: Monitor security abuse quality fairness drift and failure indicators
controls.reference_implementation: Metrics by approved cohort plus query/admin anomalies
controls.evidence_required: Dashboard; thresholds; alert test; review record

controls.title: Software Firmware and Information Integrity
controls.control_objective: Detect unauthorized change to code dependencies data and model artifacts
controls.reference_implementation: Lab SHA-256 verification; production signed provenance
controls.evidence_required: Tamper test; signature/attestation; protected verification root

controls.title: Information Input Validation
controls.control_objective: Validate API data and training inputs against defined constraints
controls.reference_implementation: Pydantic request bounds and training schema/distribution checks

controls.title: Information Management and Retention
controls.control_objective: Manage information through retention disposal and minimization rules
controls.reference_implementation: Separate minimal audit metadata from sensitive analytics data

controls.title: Predictable Failure Prevention
controls.control_objective: Detect and act before service/model failures cause unacceptable impact
controls.reference_implementation: Health capacity drift and quality thresholds with stop/rollback

controls.title: Supply Chain Controls and Processes
controls.control_objective: Establish processes for supplier and component risk
controls.reference_implementation: Inventory assess approve monitor and offboard packages/models/vendors

controls.title: Provenance
controls.control_objective: Record and verify origin and custody of components data and models
controls.reference_implementation: Dependency hashes dataset digest build identity and signed artifact

controls.title: Component Authenticity
controls.control_objective: Verify components are genuine before use
controls.reference_implementation: Signature/hash verification from trusted registries

limitations: Synthetic data and labels do not establish business validity.
Group accuracy is only a demonstration signal and is not proof of fairness.
Random split does not replace temporal or out-of-population validation.

tables.heading: Strategic scenarios
headers: Risk source → ecosystem path → target → feared event

rows.Risk source → ecosystem path → target →: Cybercriminal → compromised user/service identity → application/API → customer information → FE-01
rows.Priority rationale: Common access path with potentially severe data impact.

rows.Risk source → ecosystem path → target →: Supply-chain attacker → OSS registry/dependency → CI/training environment → credentials/data/model → FE-01/02/03
rows.Priority rationale: Open-source reliance creates a necessary external dependency.

rows.Risk source → ecosystem path → target →: Insider/process failure → source/data pipeline → training data → model behavior → FE-02/03/06
rows.Priority rationale: Integrity failures can scale silently through retraining.

rows.Risk source → ecosystem path → target →: Malicious admin → registry/deployment path → inference model → recommendations → FE-03/07
rows.Priority rationale: Privileged access can bypass normal user controls.

rows.Risk source → ecosystem path → target →: Competitor/abuser → valid inference access → repeated queries → model/commercial intelligence → FE-05
rows.Priority rationale: Predictive interfaces may leak behavior without traditional compromise.

rows.Risk source → ecosystem path → target →: External abuser/failure → API/platform/dependency → service capacity → FE-04
rows.Priority rationale: Availability and fallback needs are unknown.

rows.Risk source → ecosystem path → target →: Lifecycle failure → unrepresentative data/unchecked drift → recommendations/customer treatment → FE-06
rows.Priority rationale: AI harm can emerge without a malicious attacker.

rows.Risk source → ecosystem path → target →: Operations/process failure → over-collection or sensitive logs → unauthorized readers → FE-01/07
rows.Priority rationale: Observability can create a secondary sensitive dataset.

assumptions.text: The system is internal and recommendations are shown to authenticated sales employees.
A salesperson, not the model, makes the final offer decision.
Customer and historical sales data are used to train a predictive classifier.
The production technology stack is unknown; PostgreSQL, scikit-learn, MLflow, FastAPI, and Streamlit exist only in the lab.
Recommendations and model lifecycle events should be auditable without logging raw sensitive features.
Risk scores use the repository's 4×4 ordinal method solely for prioritization.
Customer segment is used in the synthetic lab as a fairness monitoring group, not as a legally protected attribute.
The model is refreshed periodically and can experience data/concept drift.
What is the authoritative business purpose, prohibited use, and acceptable-use boundary?
Does the salesperson always make the final decision, and can they reject/override a recommendation?
What customer attributes, special-category data, and derived features are processed?
Which jurisdictions, contracts, privacy notices, sector rules, and retention requirements apply?
What are the actual sources, interfaces, hosting environments, network zones, and third parties?
Which open-source model, packages, repositories, and licenses are used, and how is provenance verified?
Who can read source data, modify training code/data, approve a model, deploy it, query the API, and view logs?
What identity provider, MFA, secrets manager, key management, and privileged-access controls exist?
What model quality, fairness, explainability, latency, availability, and drift thresholds have business approval?
What incident, rollback, customer redress, and model retirement procedures exist?
Who owns every risk and who has authority to accept residual risk?
What risk appetite and scoring method supersede the provisional 4×4 scale?
